capabilities: Open kanban-plugin Markdown notes in a dedicated board view
Drag cards within and between columns and reorder columns
Rename columns inline and add cards via a dialog
Create linked Markdown notes for new cards with configurable folders and names
Mark cards complete and group completed cards at the bottom of columns
extras: The community listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README recommends backing up important notes before use.
intentEvidence: Use existing Obsidian Kanban notes without migration
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Kanban board, so users with Markdown-backed kanban notes either edit raw text or use a different interface without a migration path.

relations.evidence: It uses the familiar kanban-plugin: board frontmatter marker, so your boards remain portable

summary: Kanban board view that renders existing heading-based Markdown kanban notes as draggable boards without changing their file format.
